tools.name: pipe_check
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]. Cheapest paid call: proves wallet, 402 and receipt work (x402 only).

tools.name: drive_time
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/drive. Driving time/distance between two named places.

tools.name: drive_matrix
tools.description: $0.05 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/matrix. Drive-time matrix, up to 100 origin x destination elements per call.

tools.name: license_verify
tools.description: $0.05 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/license/verify. Contractor license status plus matching business-entity record. Served states: FL, OR, VA, WA. Empty licenses is a paid 200.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/entity/lookup. State business-registry record (status, formation, registered agent, officers) by entity number or exact name. Served states: FL, OR. Up to 10 entities; empty entities is a paid 200.

tools.name: license_search
tools.description: $0.10 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/license/search. Licensed contractors by trade and city or zip: license number, name, license type and class, status, expiry, address. Trades FL: alarm, demolition, drywall, electrical, garage_door,

tools.name: airport_nearest
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Pay with x402 (USDC on Base) in _meta["x402/payment"]; MPP (tempo) on the HTTP URL /v1/airport/nearest. Up to 5 airports with scheduled service nearest a named place, ranked by real road drive time, with IATA codes.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "license_search" is 2373 chars, far longer than this server's median (231). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
